description: This Java source file defines the final class BatchRequestContextHolder, which manages thread-local storage of batch request attributes and transaction status within the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to set, get, reset, and query batch request attributes and their associated transaction contexts, ensuring thread-safe handling of batch processing context.

classes.name: BatchRequestContextHolder
classes.description: A utility class providing thread-local storage for batch request attributes and transaction statuses, ensuring safe management of batch processing states.

methods.name: isBatchRequest
methods.description: Checks whether batch request attributes are currently set for the thread.

methods.name: getRequestAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's batch request attributes.

methods.name: setRequestAttributes
methods.description: Sets batch request attributes for the current thread.

methods.name: resetRequestAttributes
methods.description: Removes batch request attributes from the current thread.

methods.name: isEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Determines if the current batch context is within an enclosing transaction.

methods.name: setIsEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating whether the batch request is within an enclosing transaction.

methods.name: resetIsEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Resets the isEnclosingTransaction flag for the current thread.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction status stored for the thread.

methods.name: getEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the enclosing transaction status if the current context is within an enclosing transaction.

methods.name: setTransaction
methods.description: Sets the transaction status for the current thread.

methods.name: setEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Sets the transaction status as the enclosing transaction if the context indicates so.

methods.name: resetTransaction
methods.description: Clears the transaction status for the current thread.
